title: 第5章 太一宗魏千城第6章 风雨欲来先死为敬
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 王易没得选择，只能先同意了陈清月的要求。
但当天夜里，陈清月就带着他离开了柳州城。
她一边赶夜路，一边给王易讲述了事情经过。
“你要假扮的人叫魏千城，是太一宗七长老的四代玄孙。”
“他从小生活在万里之外的魏家村里，在祖祠老宅中长大，没有离开过村子。”
王易默默记下，提了一嘴：“我和他年纪相仿？”
“嗯，都是十六岁半。”
“那，他是怎么死的？”
陈清月侧过头，看了他一眼：“被邪修杀的。”
“死了多久？”
“不到七天。”
王易闻言一愣，似乎想到了什么，七天前，三小姐是不是刚好回到柳州城？
陈清月看出了他心里的想法，语气平淡的说道：“不是我杀的，但我亲眼看见他死了。”
魏千城被那群邪修大卸八块，挫骨扬灰，连一块完整的尸骨都没有留下。
陈清月也是拼命杀出重围，才侥幸捡回了一条小命。
“半个多月前，我接取了太一宗的一个内门任务。任务要求四名炼气弟子同行，去万里之外的魏家村，把一个名叫魏千城的少年带回宗门。”
任务奖励很丰厚，看上去也没什么难度，所以他们很快就凑齐了人手。
除了陈清月自己之外，还有一位炼气十二层的师姐和两位炼气十三层的师兄。
他们一路顺利，抵达魏家村，找到了魏千城。
但在返回宗门的半路上，一行人却遭遇了邪修伏击，三位师兄师姐当场横死，魏千城也被邪修拧下头颅，分尸碎骨。
陈清月仗着自己有一件压箱底的保命异宝，从人群中杀了出去，遁地千里，逃之夭夭。
“但我低估了邪修的手段和残忍。”
“逃到柳州城附近，那个领头的邪修堵住了我，他辛苦追杀千里，也不肯放我一条生路。”
王易默默听着，看见陈清月的眼里露出一抹寒芒。
“所以，我杀了他。”
她以命相搏，费尽手段，将邪修斩杀在了柳州城外。
王易不走心的夸了一句：“小姐果然厉害。”
陈清月只是笑了一声：“又有什么用？”
“魏千城死了，我还活着，倘若回宗复命，也难逃一番罪责。”
王易愣了一下，没太听懂：“这也不是小姐你的错啊，太一宗不是正道宗门吗？”
陈清月却没什么表情，说：“修仙者，不讲对错，正道邪道又有什么区别？”
根本没有区别，假如太一宗真是如传言中那样的正道仙门，那七长老的玄孙又怎么会是一个年轻的鬼修呢？
“为首的邪修杀了魏千城，夺走了他的储物袋，最后落在了我的手里。”
陈清月说：“三煞鬼面书也是这样得来的。”
王易大概了解事情经过，也明白了陈清月的计划。
太一宗里没人见过魏千城，见过他的三位师兄师姐都惨死在了邪修手里，所以陈清月只要找到一个身具灵根，能修行《三煞鬼面书》的十六岁少年，就可以李代桃僵，让他冒充魏千城。
唯一的问题，“太一宗七长老呢？”
魏千城是他的四代玄孙，哪怕这爷孙俩没见过，谁敢断定在一位大修士面前就不会露馅儿？
陈清月早有预料，说：“或许会，但你见不到七长老。”
王易问：“为什么？”
“因为七长老早在十年前就离开了太一宗，远赴海外，寻求渺茫的破镜仙缘，至今未归。”
“发布任务的是七长老门下弟子，他们更不可能辨别出你的身份。”
如此一来，这个计划就没了漏洞，可以说是万无一失。
content_en:
Wang Yi had no choice but to agree to Chen Qingyue's request first.
But that night, Chen Qingyue took him away from Liuzhou City.
As she walked through the night, she told Wang Yi what happened.
"The person you are pretending to be is Wei Qiancheng, the fourth-generation great-great-grandson of the seventh elder of Taiyi Sect."
"He has lived in Weijia Village thousands of miles away since he was a child. He grew up in the old house of his ancestral home and has never left the village."
Wang Yi silently noted it down and asked, "Is he and I the same age?"
"Well, they are both sixteen and a half years old."
"Then, how did he die?"
Chen Qingyue turned her head and glanced at him: "Killed by evil cultivators."
"How long have you been dead?"
"Less than seven days."
Wang Yi was stunned when he heard this, and seemed to have thought of something. Did the third lady just return to Liuzhou City seven days ago?
Chen Qingyue saw what he was thinking and said calmly: "I didn't kill him, but I saw him die with my own eyes."
Wei Qiancheng was torn into pieces by those evil cultivators, and his bones were smashed into ashes. Not even a single intact bone was left behind.
Chen Qingyue also fought her way out of the siege and was lucky enough to save a small life.
"More than half a month ago, I accepted a task from the inner sect of Taiyi Sect. The task required four Qi Refining disciples to go to Weijia Village thousands of miles away to bring a young man named Wei Qiancheng back to the sect."
The rewards for the mission were generous and it didn't seem too difficult, so they quickly gathered the manpower.
In addition to Chen Qingyue herself, there is also a senior sister who is at the twelfth level of Qi Refining and two senior brothers who are at the thirteenth level of Qi Refining.
They had a smooth journey, arrived at Weijia Village, and found Wei Qiancheng.
But on the way back to the sect, the group was ambushed by evil cultivators. Three brothers and sisters died on the spot. Wei Qiancheng was also decapitated by evil cultivators and his body was cut into pieces.
Chen Qingyue relied on the fact that she had a life-saving treasure at the bottom of the box, so she fought her way out of the crowd and fled thousands of miles away.
"But I underestimated the methods and cruelty of evil cultivators."
"I fled near Liuzhou City, but the leading evil cultivator blocked me. He hunted me for thousands of miles, but he refused to let me live."
Wang Yi listened silently and saw a cold light in Chen Qingyue's eyes.
"So, I killed him."
She risked her life and tried her best to kill the evil cultivator outside Liuzhou City.
Wang Yi praised without hesitation: "Young lady is really amazing."
Chen Qingyue just laughed: "What's the use?"
"Wei Qiancheng is dead, but I am still alive. If I return to my clan and return to my life, I will not be able to escape the guilt."
Wang Yi was stunned for a moment and didn't quite understand: "This is not your fault, Miss. Isn't Taiyi Sect an orthodox sect?"
Chen Qingyue, however, showed no expression and said: "For immortal cultivators, if you don't talk about right and wrong, what's the difference between right and wrong?"
There is no difference at all. If Taiyi Sect is really a righteous immortal sect as rumored, then how can the great-great-grandson of the seventh elder be a young ghost cultivator?
"The evil cultivator led by him killed Wei Qiancheng and took away his storage bag, which finally fell into my hands."
Chen Qingyue said: "This is how the Three Evil Ghost Faces were obtained."
Wang Yi roughly understood what happened and Chen Qingyue's plan.
No one in Taiyi Sect has ever seen Wei Qiancheng, and the three senior brothers and sisters who have seen him all died tragically at the hands of evil cultivators, so Chen Qingyue only needs to find a 16-year-old boy with spiritual roots and the ability to practice "Three Evil Ghost Faces", so he can replace Tao Zhan and let him pretend to be Wei Qiancheng.
The only question is, "Where are the seven elders of Taiyi Sect?"
Wei Qiancheng is his fourth-generation great-great-grandson. Even if he and his grandson have never met, who dares to say that his secret will not be exposed in front of a great monk?
Chen Qingyue had already expected it and said, "Maybe, but you won't be able to see the seventh elder."
Wang Yi asked: "Why?"
"Because the seventh elder left Taiyi Sect ten years ago and went overseas to seek the elusive fate of breaking the mirror. He has not returned yet."
"The person who issued the mission is a disciple of the Seventh Elder. It is even more impossible for them to identify you."
In this way, this plan has no loopholes and can be said to be foolproof.
title_en: Chapter 5 Taiyi Zong Wei Qiancheng Chapter 6 When the storm is about to come, die first to respect
